question: Should `createNativeApprovalMessagingTargetResolvers` be accepted as a supported public Plugin SDK API for external messaging-channel plugins?
rationale: The code removes repeated bundled-plugin logic, but exporting and documenting the helper makes its normalization behavior a compatibility commitment beyond this refactor.

options.title: Accept the SDK contract
options.body: Merge the additive resolver as the documented reusable contract after confirming its normalization semantics are appropriate for external plugin authors.

options.title: Keep the refactor internal
options.body: Avoid exporting the helper and retain a bundled-only shared implementation if maintainers do not want to support this API externally.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Merge the additive resolver as the documented reusable contract after confirming its normalization semantics are appropriate for external plugin authors.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository-member author is the only directly evidenced current contributor to this focused approval-routing and SDK-surface change.
